title: staging: no cleanup for orphaned files after cancelled try_stage
description:
## Bug

In StagingArea::try_stage(), fs::write() runs before the BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. If the future is cancelled between fs::write() and COMMIT (e.g., peer disconnects mid-staging), the file is left on disk without a DB row.

The comment says 'will be cleaned up by the next GC pass' but no such pass exists — there is no cleanup_orphans or scan_dir function in staging.rs or the GC module.

## Impact
Orphaned files accumulate in the staging directory on every abnormal teardown that occurs mid-staging. Over time this leaks disk space.

## Fix
Add async cleanup_orphans() to StagingArea that scans the staging directory for files whose ID does not appear in transit_staging, and deletes them. Call at drain-task startup alongside reset_claims().
